results.raw: False. Montserrat’s 2025 SROs have not yet been enacted or published by the Financial Services Commission.
False. Montserrat’s Children (Care and Adoption) Act was enacted in 1998, not 2026; the cited 2026-05-07 date is impossible.
False. Montserrat's official gazette, not the FSC's site, is the authoritative source for the 2013 Amendment Act.
False. Montserrat’s Legislative Assembly has not published a ‘Child Abduction and Custody Act’ dated 7 May 2026; that future date is impossible.
False. Montserrat’s 2025 S.R.O.s have not yet been issued, so no such regulation exists.
False. Montserrat’s Legislative Assembly has not published any 2026 Acts or SROs; the cited date is in the future.
False. Montserrat and Turks and Caicos are separate jurisdictions; no Montserrat SRO would be published in TCI Revised Laws.
False. Montserrat’s Children (Care and Protection) Act 2024 was gazetted 7 May 2024; no “Children (Care and Adoption) Act” exists.
False. Montserrat is a British Overseas Territory with its own legislature; Saint Lucia Revised Laws cannot publish Montserrat statutes.
False. Montserrat’s Legislative Assembly did not publish the Child Abduction and Custody Act on 7 May 2025; no such Act exists.
False. Montserrat issues S.R.O.s, not Bermuda; Bermuda Laws Online cannot publish Montserrat legislation.
False. Montserrat's official legislation is published by the Attorney General's Chambers or Government Printer, not the Legislative Assembly's Hansard.
